## zarf_package_mirror_resources

Push a package's images and repositories into a registry and git server.

Write it as `colonel_byte.zarf.zarf_package_mirror_resources`. It runs zarf on the node the task is delegated to; nothing is installed on the cluster's nodes.

Added in `colonel_byte.zarf` 0.88.0.

Runs `zarf package mirror-resources`, which pushes the images and git repositories a package carries into a registry and a git server without deploying anything.

The module is a compiled binary with zarf linked into it. It renders the `zarf package mirror-resources` command line from these parameters, executes zarf's own command in its own process, reads the component boundaries back out of zarf's log stream, and reports one JSON result. It needs no `zarf` on the node.

It is the air-gap seeding step. A cluster that deploys with `connected: true` pulls the images itself, which means its registry has to hold them first, and before this module a playbook had no way to say so.

### Parameters

| Parameter                   | Type   | Required | Flag                          | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| --------------------------- | ------ | -------- | ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `package`                   | `str`  | yes      | None                          | The package whose resources are mirrored: a path to a tarball, an `oci://` reference, or an `https://` URL. The positional argument of the command, so it renders no flag.                                                                                                |
| `kubeconfig`                | `str`  | no       | None                          | The kubeconfig of the cluster whose registry and git server are the destination, for a mirror that reads them out of the cluster's zarf state rather than being given them below. Zarf has no `--kubeconfig` flag, so it is passed as `KUBECONFIG` in zarf's environment. |
| `zarf_config`               | `str`  | no       | None                          | A zarf config file, passed as `ZARF_CONFIG`. It is how a playbook keeps the push credentials out of the argument vector.                                                                                                                                                  |
| `status_file`               | `str`  | no       | None                          | Where the wrapper writes live component progress. The action plugin creates a private temporary file and overrides this.                                                                                                                                                  |
| `wrapper_binary`            | `str`  | no       | None                          | The module wrapper to run, resolved on the path when it holds no separator. The action plugin consumes this parameter; the wrapper never sees it.                                                                                                                         |
| `parameters`                | `dict` | no       | None                          | Further module parameters, merged into the ones given directly. A parameter given both directly and inside `parameters` is an error naming it. The action plugin consumes this key; the wrapper never sees it.                                                            |
| `images`                    | `bool` | no       | `--images`                    | Mirror only the images. Mutually exclusive with `repos`. It is also what lets the progress display report a total, the way `components` does: see `components`.                                                                                                           |
| `repos`                     | `bool` | no       | `--repos`                     | Mirror only the git repositories. Mutually exclusive with `images`.                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `components`                | `str`  | no       | `--components`                | Which of the package's components to mirror, as a comma-separated list. It is also what lets the progress display report `component 2/4` rather than `component 2`: the wrapper cannot otherwise know how many components the package holds.                              |
| `registry_url`              | `str`  | no       | `--registry-url`              | The registry to push the images to, for a destination that is not the one the cluster's zarf state names.                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `registry_push_username`    | `str`  | no       | `--registry-push-username`    | The registry's push username.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `registry_push_password`    | `str`  | no       | `--registry-push-password`    | The registry's push password.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `git_url`                   | `str`  | no       | `--git-url`                   | The git server to push the repositories to.                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `git_push_username`         | `str`  | no       | `--git-push-username`         | The git server's push username.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `git_push_password`         | `str`  | no       | `--git-push-password`         | The git server's push password.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `shasum`                    | `str`  | no       | `--shasum`                    | The SHA256 checksum of a package fetched over `https://`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

| `verify`                    | `str`  | no       | `--verify`                    | When to verify the package signature. One of `never`, `if-possible`, `always`.                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `skip_signature_validation` | `bool` | no       | `--skip-signature-validation` | Whether zarf skips validating the package's signature altogether.                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `retries`                   | `int`  | no       | `--retries`                   | How many times zarf retries a failed push.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `oci_concurrency`           | `int`  | no       | `--oci-concurrency`           | How many OCI operations zarf runs at once.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

Defaults to `json`, which is the format the component progress is read out of.                                                                                                                                                                         |

### Notes

- Set `run_once: true` and `delegate_to` on the task. One mirror fills the registry the whole cluster pulls from.
- Set `no_log: true` on the task when any push credential is given as a parameter, or name a zarf config file with `zarf_config` and keep them out of the argument vector.
- The task reports `changed: true` with `zarf.changedSignal` set to `partial` and the components it mirrored in `zarf.componentsRan`, the same way the converging modules do and for the same reason: zarf reports which components it walked, not whether the registry already held what was pushed.
- Check mode reports the task as skipped. The command has no dry run.
- `images` and `repos` are mutually exclusive, as they are in zarf. Setting both is an error naming them; leaving both unset mirrors everything.
- A parameter left unset renders no flag, so whatever zarf's own config file sets still applies.

### Example

```yaml
- name: Seed the cluster's registry so a connected deploy can find the images
  colonel_byte.zarf.zarf_package_mirror_resources:
    package: /srv/staging/zarf-package-monitoring-amd64.tar.zst
    kubeconfig: /etc/rancher/rke2/rke2.yaml
    public_key: /etc/zarf/colonel-byte-zarf-packages.pub
    verify: always
  delegate_to: localhost
  run_once: true
  register: mirror_result

- name: Deploy without pushing the images again
  colonel_byte.zarf.zarf_package_deploy:
    package: /srv/staging/zarf-package-monitoring-amd64.tar.zst
    connected: true
    kubeconfig: /etc/rancher/rke2/rke2.yaml
  delegate_to: localhost
  run_once: true

- name: Push only the images, to a registry outside the cluster
  colonel_byte.zarf.zarf_package_mirror_resources:
    package: oci://ghcr.io/colonel-byte/zarf/monitoring:1.0.0
    images: true
    registry_url: registry.bubbles.test
    registry_push_username: zarf-push
    registry_push_password: "{{ registry_password }}"
  delegate_to: localhost
  run_once: true
  no_log: true

- name: Report which components were mirrored
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    var: mirror_result.zarf.componentsRan
```
